fields.description: Issue of Miami Life ("Florida's Most Influential Weekly") dated March 30, 1935 (Vol. 9, no. 28). Includes editorials and commentary on Miami-area public issues, notably a campaign against loan sharks and wage-buyers and criticism of greyhound racing as "legalized robbery." Contains extensive racing and sports coverage (including Tropical Park season closing and handicapping tips), nightlife and entertainment columns, local social and "round the town" items, and assorted local news briefs and advertisements tied to Miami, Miami Beach, and Coral Gables.
